name: Being A Blessing
overview: Scripture reveals that being a blessing is rooted in God's sovereign design and abundant provision, as He has blessed believers with every spiritual blessing in Christ (Ephesians 1:3). Children are specifically highlighted as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), reflecting His intimate involvement in their creation and purpose (Psalms 139:13). Believers are called to let their good works shine before others, glorifying God through their lives (Matthew 5:16), and like the joyful relief following childbirth (John 16:21), the blessing of others brings lasting joy. God's plans for His people are always for peace and hope, underscoring that our role as blessings is part of His good and purposeful design (Jeremiah 29:11).
